events.description: The scene initializes in 3D with a central glowing light source and axes, followed by an outward-propagating radiation wave.
events.clip_query: A glowing white dot at the center of 3D axes with an expanding spherical wave of light.

events.description: A small parametric patch is highlighted on the sphere's surface, and a focused beam of light projects outward from it while the camera rotates.
events.clip_query: A small white square patch highlighted on a 3D sphere with a beam of light projecting outward.

events.description: The sphere and the patch scale up by a factor of 2, demonstrating radial propagation.
events.clip_query: The sphere and the highlighted patch expand outward to twice their original size.

events.description: Division lines appear on the expanded patch, splitting it into 4 equal sub-patches to illustrate the inverse square law.
events.clip_query: Grid lines divide the expanded patch on the sphere into four smaller equal squares.
